dual.order: cycle c = 1..20000: odd POINT -> FLOW, even FLOW -> POINT
dual.optimizer: ONE AdamW(all parameters, lr 1e-3, weight decay 0.01), constant LR; per substep zero_grad(set_to_none) -> task loss backward -> the other task's private parameters have grad None (checked) and are skipped by AdamW -> clip_grad_norm 1.0 over shared + this task's private parameters -> step
dual.flow_stream: batches and FM noise / t identical to SPECIALIST G's
dual.flow_loss: MSE(v, x1 - x0) (scaleflow draw order: x0 then t)
